Innocage® IVC Mouse XL

Extra large mouse bottom designed for more than 5 mice and is compatible with Innorack IVC Rat. It’s intended for mouse applications on your existing Innovive IVC Rat rack. Available empty or pre-bedded.
  • Research-Ready
  • 100% PET
  • PBA-Free
  • Recyclable

Features

  • Potential use: mouse breeding
  • Flexible, standardized, research-ready caging
  • Patented lightweight caging
  • 14-day cage changes 
  • Completely disposable end-to-end solution
  • Closed-loop recycling services available

Engineered for the Modern Vivarium

01

No Cage Washing

The use of disposable caging in your facility alleviates the strenuous labor, constant repairs, and the operational pain of a washroom. It frees up the space, time, and capital with the Innovive Research-Ready IVC System.

02

Patented Lightweight Design

This innovative cage bottom changed the way lab animal research is conducted, removing the barrier for entry for many companies, simplifying ACFs workflow, and improving animal welfare, and the day-to-day workflow and experience of animal care technicians.

03

Sustainable

Innocage® IVC Mouse bottom is made from 100% PET plastic and can be recycled after use with bedding. This approach removes cage dumping from your facility. Our Closed-Loop Recycling program picks up used caging from your facility, transforming your operations and making them science-focused.

Product Specifications

Sized forMore than 5 miceFor Use WithInnorack IVC RatInterior Dimensions146 in2 (942 cm2) floor space, 5.8” H (14.8 cm H) of headroom Outside Dimensions17”L x 13.4”W x 5.8”H (max) (43.2 cm L x 34.0 cm W x 14.8 cm H (max))Cage TypeOffers more space than Universal Euro Type II Long and Universal Euro Type III cagesLidsDual filter IVC rat (RVX62), static (RSX1) FeederR-FEED-UWater Bottle ProtectorR-WBP WaterM-WB-850 (Acidified, Purified*, Chlorinated*)

*Available upon request

Bedding Options

ALPHA-Dri

ALPHA-Dri bedding is ideal for GLP research. Standard disposable mouse cage bottom arrives pre-bedded and ready for use with ALPHA-Dri. Perfect for GLP studies.

  • M-BTM-AD (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri)
  • M-BTM-ADE (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri with 3-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-ADE-1 (Pre-bedded, ALPHA-Dri with 1-ply Innorichment)

Key Advantages:

  • Dust elimination: Clean and virtually dustless bedding helps reduce cross-contamination, filter clogging, and possible issues of dust adherence to animals.
  • Better for animal observation: Bright, white color aids in animal observation.
  • Exceptional absorbency.
  • Environmentally friendly.
  • Delivered irradiated.

Corn Cob

Corn Cob is proven to encapsulate the urea crystals found in animal urine, controlling ammonia levels. Its sponge-like characteristics encapsulate ammonia and trap associated odors.

  • M-BTM-C4 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob)
  • M-BTM-C4E (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 3-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-C4E-1 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 1-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-C8 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob)
  • M-BTM-C8E (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 3-ply Innorichment)
  • M-BTM-C8E-1 (Pre-bedded, Corn Cob with 1-ply Innorichment)

Key Advantages:

  • Will not cling to animals or cages.
  • Fast-wicking absorption.
  • Resistant to cage flooding from water bottle drip.
  • Perfect for isolator and IVC cages.
  • Environmentally friendly.
  • Available in 1/4 in (C4) and 1/8 in (C8) sizes.
  • Delivered irradiated.
